## What it is

Couvercle du boîtier de dérivation coffeeflow. Impression tête en bas : face extérieure sur le plateau, jupe en +Z. Deux vis M3 (pas M4) dans les piliers du boîtier.

## Design notes

The plate is 1.6 mm and sits on the box walls, closing the U-notches from above. A 2.5 mm skirt nests on the two walls that have no wire notches (Wago side and the +X end). The notched walls stay clear so wires are not pinched by a jupe.

Same inner 62 x 30 mm and 1.6 mm walls as `boitier`. Bambu Studio: export STL, not nurb 3MF.

## Don't

- Do not run a full-perimeter skirt. Slots in the jupe at the notched walls left 0.05–0.12 mm films and sliver faces, including where the exits meet the long wall.
- Do not U-cut or slot the skirt for the wires; omit the jupe on those two walls instead.
- Do not put the three exit notches on the +X short face; they belong on x = 0, matching the box.
- Do not polish inner skirt edges. Same rule as the box: outer corners only.
- Do not change the lid holes to M4. Clearance is ISO 273 medium for M3 (3.4 mm).

## Changelog

- Skirt reduced to the two un-notched walls.
- Exit side is the -X face, with the box.
